object.attr: as implemented: mapped from the existing tests, with blind tests written from the requirements alone for what they missed.
object.description: Resolve a merge with two conflicting document files, and make the resolution fail after the first file is written, for example with the second file read-only. Remove the cause and resolve again. Expected: both files end merged and marked resolved, with the same content as a resolution that never failed. Resolving twice is tested, but a partial failure isn't.
